company.shortDescription: Dailymealz is a healthy food subscription app, delivers fresh, healthy, and tasty meals.
company.description:
Dailymealz bringing together the best healthy food restaurants in Saudi Arabia and kuwait with skilled inventors to make a great everyday dining experience. Our engineers along with our professional drivers make eating a healthy food every day is simple.
The company was founded in 2017 and based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.
